title: Phantom Blade Zero Pre-Order Guide - Is It Worth It?
description: What you actually get for pre-ordering Phantom Blade Zero: the Treasure Basin accessory and Legacy outfit, both of which are also obtainable in-game. Price, editions and where to buy.

facts.label: Pre-order bonus
facts.value: Treasure Basin accessory (+10% Remnant Dust drop rate) + Legacy appearance

facts.label: Bonus exclusivity
facts.value: Pre-order bonus obtainable in-game; the two Deluxe outfits are labelled Exclusive, unresolved

facts.label: Deluxe edition
facts.value: $69.99 - Wulin Legend and Blood-Steel Form outfits, artbook, OST

facts.label: Where to buy
facts.value: PlayStation Store, Steam, Epic Games Store

facts.label: Physical edition
facts.value: Not available at launch - retailer listing withdrawn

sections.title: The Short Version
sections.content:
There is no gameplay reason to pre-order. The two announced bonuses - the Treasure Basin accessory and the Legacy outfit - can both be obtained through normal in-game progression. They are cosmetics, not power.

That is a genuinely favourable position for a buyer, because it means the pre-order is not a tax on impatience. If you want the game, pre-ordering costs you nothing you cannot get later. If you would rather wait for reviews, you are not losing content by doing so.

sections.title: What You Actually Get
sections.content:
ItemTypeExclusive?
Treasure BasinAccessoryNo - also in-game
Legacy outfitCosmeticNo - also in-game

This comes from the official PlayStation announcement that opened pre-orders on August 11, 2026, which states plainly that both items can also be obtained through in-game progression.

No early access period has been announced, so pre-ordering does not get you in before October 29 either.

sections.title: What Has Not Been Announced
sections.content:
Worth being precise here, because a lot of pages fill these gaps with guesses:

  • Standard price. Not confirmed. Any figure you see quoted pre-launch is speculation.
  • Deluxe or collector editions. None announced as of the pre-order opening.
  • Season pass or post-launch content plan. Not announced. The game is not described as a live-service title.
  • Demo. No public demo has been announced. The footage circulating is from closed demos and the State of Play showcase.
  • Day-one patch size or pre-load date. Not announced.

sections.title: Where to Buy
sections.content:
Reservations opened simultaneously across all three storefronts on August 11, 2026 rather than staggering by platform:

  • PlayStation 5 - PlayStation Store
  • PC - Steam
  • PC - Epic Games Store

There is no Xbox or Nintendo Switch version announced, and PS5 is a timed console exclusive for 12 months. If you are deciding between Steam and Epic, the choice is about your library rather than about content - see the PC requirements page for the technical picture.

sections.title: Should You Pre-Order?
sections.content:
Given the bonus structure, the honest framing is:

  • Pre-order if you want to guarantee a day-one download and do not care about the money being spent before reviews exist. You lose nothing by doing it.
  • Wait if you want to know how the performance holds up on your hardware, or whether the difficulty modes work as described. You give up nothing except the small chance of a storefront sale.

The one thing that would change this calculus is a deluxe edition with meaningful content, which has not been announced. Watch the release date page for updates.

sections.title: What changed this week
sections.content:
Prices are now published, so the earlier “not announced” line is gone. Standard is $59.99 and Digital Deluxe $69.99 on Steam in the US. Pre-ordering Deluxe also carries the pre-order bonuses.

One honest ambiguity: the official page says bonus content can also be obtained through in-game progression, but it prints that line under both edition blocks while separately labelling the two Deluxe appearances as Exclusive. Those two statements cannot both hold, so treat the Deluxe outfits as paid-only until it is cleared up.

There is no early access in any edition, and no physical PlayStation 5 version at launch - Play-Asia removed its boxed listing after being told none was coming. A later boxed release is speculation, not an announcement.

Source: listings checked by GamerFuzion, 2026-10-13.
